title: EventBus same plugin/event different callback contract

contract.same_plugin_event_multiple_callbacks: The same plugin may register multiple distinct callbacks for the same event
contract.different_callback_registration: Registering a different callback for an existing plugin/event pair returns True and adds the callback
contract.callback_independence: Each distinct callback is retained as a separate listener
contract.delivery: All registered distinct callbacks for the same plugin/event receive the emitted event
contract.delivery_order: Callbacks are delivered in listener registration order
contract.duplicate_scope: Registration idempotency applies to the same callback; a different callback is treated as a distinct listener
contract.registry_stability: Multiple callbacks for the same plugin/event remain structurally stable after emit
contract.permission_enforcement: Each registration continues to require the events permission
